{{Top|leg}}
'''Operation Glory Cyclone''' was a two-part military operation carried out by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron and the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] carried out an [[Battle of the Pakuuni system|emergency defense]] of a neutral [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Pakuuni system/Legends|Pakuuni system]], and [[Battle above Kovor|rescued a Republic patrol]] from an Imperial ambush.
